Compile the following natural-language recipe into a typed Recipe by calling submit_recipe.

Recipe name: default
Natural-language specification:
Each task runs swe -> clean -> review -> integrate. SWE implements the change, runs lint and scoped tests, and opens a ready PR. Clean trims redundant comments and polishes the PR without changing behavior. Review checks the PR against the brief and the repository's documented gates; if review reports needs-swe, return to swe on the next round (up to 3 rounds, then escalate). Integrate uses the repository's documented merge path once review passes on the pinned HEAD.
